mainText:
Good evening. Weather in Prishtina: 10 degrees now, moderate rain. Next 24 hours: high 14, low 6.

President Donald Trump said Russian President Vladimir Putin could become even harsher in his war against Ukraine, though Trump believes the Kremlin leader is already under pressure.

Trump also said he would not object if Jensen Huang returned as chief executive of Nvidia after the former CEO stepped down last week.

The Grammy Awards announced their 2027 nominations, with British singer Raye leading the list with eleven nods, while Dolly Parton received three posthumous nominations.

The public prosecutor in Ohrid filed an indictment and requested pre-trial detention for a man accused of raping a 26-year-old woman during a domestic-violence incident.

Congress authorized a detective to investigate the death of an American citizen in Kosovo; lawyer Fehmije Bytyqi raised concerns about the case, and detective Fatmir Bardhoci warned of possible manipulation.
